context: Back-office roles (HR and other non-customer-facing functions) under a hiring pause
estimateBasis: CEO-stated 30% of ~26,000 back-office roles = 7,800 over five years
quote: I could easily see 30% of that getting replaced by AI and automation over a five-year period.
description: CEO Arvind Krishna told Bloomberg IBM would pause hiring for roles AI could do, citing roughly 26,000 non-customer-facing back-office roles, and said 30% could be replaced by AI and automation over five years. IBM later said there was no blanket hiring 'pause', describing selective backfilling instead. AskHR handles 94% of routine HR queries. Moved from the layoffs and planned datasets on 2026-10-02 (owner ruling): positions not refilled, not layoffs.

sources.title: IBM to pause hiring in plan to replace 7,800 jobs with AI
IBM CEO says AI could replace back-office jobs; hiring paused

context: Company-wide headcount reduced through a hiring freeze and natural attrition, enabled by AI
estimateBasis: Company-stated headcount drop from ~5,000 to ~3,800 via hiring freeze and attrition
quote: [The AI assistant is] doing the equivalent work of 700 full-time agents.
description: CEO Sebastian Siemiatkowski said Klarna's workforce fell from about 5,000 to 3,800 in a year by not replacing departing staff, with its AI assistant doing the work of about 700 customer-service agents. He set a target of about 2,000 employees (a further ~1,800, not counted here as it is a target). Klarna later said it 'went too far' and resumed some human hiring in 2025. Moved from the layoffs and planned datasets on 2026-10-02 (owner ruling); the planned entry's '2,000' was the target headcount, not a cut count.

context: Contract and temporary roles not renewed as AI takes on the work, across 19 markets
estimateBasis: Company-stated ~4,000 of ~8,000-9,000 contract/temp roles not renewed over three years
quote: The reduction in workforce will come from 'natural attrition' as temporary and contract roles roll off over the next few years.
description: CEO Piyush Gupta, replying to Bloomberg News, said DBS plans to reduce around 4,000 of its roughly 8,000-9,000 contract and temporary staff over three years as AI takes on their roles, through non-renewal rather than layoffs. Permanent staff are not affected; DBS also expects to create about 1,000 AI-related roles.

sources.title: DBS CEO sees job cuts of 4,000 temp staff as AI replaces roles
